integrity: The rank-one case is solved directly from ideal containment and the square of A^2. The perfect and prime implications are matched to the inspected source theorems. A standalone exhaustive checker verifies semiprimeness and primeness from their definitions over four finite fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the full-support two-vertex graph fiber relative to a fixed natural basis.
Finite-field formulas count structure matrices, not isomorphism classes.
Equivalent rank-one criteria may exist in low-dimensional classification literature under different coordinates.
title: The complete two-vertex evolution graph has an exact semiprime defect locus
